name: requestdesk/magento-blog
description: RequestDesk Blog Extension - Native blog functionality with RequestDesk API integration for Magento 2

suggest.requestdesk/magento-qa: Enables the paid Q&A integration — attach shared Q&A pairs to blog posts and emit FAQPage schema. The blog runs fully standalone without it.
suggest.requestdesk/magento-aeo: Adds product AEO scoring and product FAQ schema from the shared Q&A library. Recommended companion; disable or replace RequestDesk_Aeo freely — the blog does not depend on it.
